source.author: verg
source.text: coniugium vocat; hoc praetexit nomine culpam.
source.text_original: coniugium vocat; hoc praetexit nomine culpam.
source.text_english: She calls it a marriage; by this name she conceals her guilt.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Virgilianum consilium est: Conjugium vocat, hoc praetexit nomine culpam..
reuse.text_original: Virgilianum consilium est: Conjugium vocat, hoc praetexit nomine culpam..
reuse.text_english: It is Virgil’s phrase: he calls it marriage; under this name he conceals the fault.
